issues_found.issue: botShoot now applies full stats.soak damage with NO spread and NO miss check on any LOS-valid frame (old code used traceShot+spread and dealt WEAPON.damage*0.8). Bots can never whiff, and the damage is multiplied by bot.rarityMult (defaults to 1, but if bots are ever given rarity a legendary petalbow bot lands ~72 soak/hit). This inverts the old 'deliberately worse than a human' design intent — bots are now strictly more accurate than a human.
issues_found.suggestion: Keep a skill gate: re-run a traceShot-style hit test (or add a miss/spread chance) before c.onHit, and/or cap bot rarityMult for the tactical mode, so bots stay beatable by movement.

issues_found.issue: PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by this PR): heals adjust the client's hp+soak locally, but the sim only ever raises soak on damage and never lowers it on heal. The next damage event recomputes hp = 100 - soak and snaps the healed bar back, so a heal item is effectively cancelled for a damaged player. This predates D1-D3.
issues_found.suggestion: Make heal authoritative in the sim: on a heal event do target.soak = max(0, target.soak - heal) so client and sim agree. Flag for the next pass; not a regression from this PR.

issues_found.issue: Bot ranged range uses `stats.range ?? 120`; petalbow/bubbler/splatter/confetti have no `range` field, so bots apply soak out to 120m regardless of the projectile's real travel/gravity. A bot can 'hit' from farther than a player's projectile would reach.
issues_found.suggestion: Give soak tools an explicit `range`, or clamp bot firing distance to the projectile's effective range.

issues_found.issue: _recoveryUntil is assigned on the 'Exposed!' tell but never read anywhere, so the 'punishable opening' after a whiff is visual only, not mechanically enforced.
issues_found.suggestion: Either wire a real movement/action lock during recovery, or drop the dead variable. (Engineer flagged this as a deliberate follow-up.)

issues_found.issue: this.soak is never initialized in the MatchMode constructor (only set on damage/heal/down). Harmless today because the HUD derives soak from 100 - this.hp, but fragile for future readers.
issues_found.suggestion: Add `this.soak = 0;` in the constructor next to `this.hp = 100;`.
